name: Outer Peal
effect: Two offset tuning marks create a deliberate safe middle lane and two short outer pulses; distinct from an all-around ring. Field: Synchronize a pair of already marked seam latches; preserves basic ore and single-latch use.

name: Slack Tether
effect: Set a slack tether that tightens only after an ordinary target crosses the far endpoint; one swept pull. Field: Reel a load along a pictured bypass while holding the first safe tie; old one-stop reeling unchanged.

name: Cooling Crescent
effect: Carry one heat packet during a short approach, then leave a slow cooling crescent behind; no persistent player aura. Field: Transfer stored heat between a high and low shelf while preserving the marked warm shelter.

name: Seed Skip
effect: A two-stage seed skip follows a previewed dogleg and stops at the first wall; not free hero movement. Field: Lay a marked angled branch span that leaves an awning ventilation slot open.

name: Split Spillway
effect: Carve two short offset ridges with a walkable channel between; ordinary enemies are redirected, no solid player trap. Field: Clear a selected shallow spillway so shade-garden runoff avoids its visibly dry root bed.

name: Quiet Cut
effect: A short quiet cut cancels one marked ordinary enemy windup only from the indicated side; bosses retain telegraphs. Field: Listen to a visible seam and rotate its tagged latch one stop; substitutes for ordinary tune-latch or draw-ore targets.

name: Hush Wedge
effect: Leave one direction-facing quiet wedge; it cancels the next eligible ordinary shot entering its front, then closes. Field: Hold a seam open while reading a second marked hinge; no effect on untagged doors.

name: Side Ripple
effect: A forward ripple carries one small ordinary enemy at most eight swept pixels and deposits it sideways in a previewed pocket. Field: Float a tagged reed delivery skiff, then connect two existing marked landing pools; no free swimming.

name: Meeting Wakes
effect: Launch paired unequal wakes that meet at one visible tip; each enemy receives only one total hit per cast. Field: Maintain one skiff float while pivoting a marked pool link to an alternate safe landing.

name: Hem Draw
effect: A narrow strip travels outward, then returns along the identical clear segment. Outward damage1 or returning damage2, never both on one enemy; spacing favors the return. Field: Pull one cloth-tagged light carriage one socket toward the cast origin along its authored straight rail; side approaches refuse. Never moves the player.

name: Corner Hem
effect: One two-leg ribbon turns once at a visible elbow, total travel64px. Each leg clips independently against solids and no enemy takes more than2 total damage. Field: Guide that cloth carriage through one marked right-angle rail corner selected by one fresh cardinal edge in the first8 active updates. Each leg requires fresh visible contact.

name: Warm Vessel
effect: After a visible charge, fresh R releases one radius12 pulse at the fixed cast origin; damage2. No release by update30 dissipates harmlessly; no automatic healing. Field: Gather warmth from a marked warm plate, then release the current cast into its adjacent seam after a fresh R. One fixed local transfer, no carried heat across rooms.

name: Hearth Veil
effect: A stationary crescent catches at most one eligible ordinary hostile shot, then releases a short forward ember on fresh R; damage3 only after a catch,1 without. No boss-shot reflection. Field: Transfer heat between one source and one shielded target on a short straight bench; a manually placed hood must leave the marked vent open.

name: Measured Nudge
effect: A short ground wedge hits once for2 and nudges only ordinary movable enemies up to8px if the destination is clear; bosses take normal damage without displacement. Field: Move one tagged counterweight exactly one notch away from the caster on a three-notch rail; end stops and an occupied destination refuse without movement.

name: Terrace Measure
effect: Two spatially separated ground pulses, one near then one far. Enemies take at most3 total, and the near empty gap rewards deliberate range choice. Field: Choose left or right notch during the first8 updates and settle a tagged weight there only after its two foot pads receive the two visible beats; no arbitrary terrain creation.

name: Shallow Prism
effect: A short forward water blade stops at its first wall. A fresh early cardinal edge sets one of two small lateral offsets; damage2, no ricochet. Field: Tilt one marked water-lens tray to one of two pictured bearings; a beam must visibly reach both lens and recipient along clear authored segments.

name: Paired Prism
effect: A near water blade and delayed far glint share one cast and once-per-enemy ledger; maximum3 damage, each clipped to visible geometry. Field: Light two adjacent marked receivers from one tray in a fixed near-then-far sequence after selecting its manual shutter; both clear segments must be demonstrated.

name: Rail Flick
effect: A committed narrow metal tongue reaches36px for3 damage with long settle; side flanks stay exposed and the player never dashes. Field: Turn a tagged empty rail junction a quarter-turn; a carriage occupying it prevents movement and receives a clear refusal.

name: Leaf Shelter
effect: A small stationary arc cancels at most one ordinary hostile shot and gives one contact hit for1; no invulnerability, boss cancellation or permanent shield. Field: Unfold one tagged woven screen without covering the nearby nesting aperture; only the marked hinged frame changes state.

name: Backspark
effect: A quarter-arc starts beside the caster and sweeps behind for2 damage, leaving the forward lane empty; orientation changes only during the first8 updates. Field: Ignite a marked side wick from its sheltered flank; the open front face is deliberately unreceptive and visibly patterned differently.

name: Still Hoof
effect: A short grounded frontal shove deals1 with extra ordinary-enemy stagger; no full-body armor or immunity. A rear attack remains effective. Field: Hold a tagged balance plate at its current notch while the player operates an adjacent manual latch; hold ends with the cast and never seals an exit.

name: Twin Click
effect: Two narrow parallel strokes release at different times; choose facing early to place the gap. Maximum2 total per enemy; no damage in the visible gap. Field: Open a marked resonant latch with a short-long visual pulse pattern; repeated brute-force casts reset only that latch, and the pattern is also painted.

name: Split Pour
effect: Two unequal splash discs land beside a short forward path; at most2 power objects and2 total damage per enemy. The empty center line stays safe. Field: Fill two adjacent small marked bowls to their pictured unequal marks in a fixed sequence; an overflow lip visibly drains excess, without timers.

name: Root Stitch
effect: A stationary short root strip damages a crossing ordinary enemy once for2 and briefly slows it; boss speed unchanged and no stacking slow. Field: Grow one soft root strip along a marked cracked garden seam; it changes a tagged clue/work object only, never makes unbounded bridges or new solids.

name: Bright Clap
effect: A short expanding forward fan deals2, wide at its far edge and narrow near the caster; one contact per enemy and no wall penetration. Field: Turn a tagged light vane one stop after a matching manual counterweight is set; clapping against the marked stop does nothing and explains why.
